description: This file defines the PosUnary class, which is part of the Twig templating engine. It represents a unary positive operator within the expression node hierarchy, specifically for handling the unary plus operation in Twig expressions.

classes.name: PosUnary
classes.description: Represents the unary plus ('+') operation in Twig's expression syntax. Extends AbstractUnary to implement the specific operator logic.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the compilation output for the unary plus operator, which outputs a '+' symbol into the compiled template code.
